import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 1000005;
    static final int M1 = 998244353;
    static final int M2 = 1000000007;
    static final int B = 1000000;

    static long n;
    static List<Integer>[] seqs = new ArrayList[10];
    static long count = 0;
    static int[] prefixSumArr = new int[10];
    static int result = 0;

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            seqs[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static void generate(int level, long val) {
        seqs[level].add((int)((++count - val + M1) % M1));
        prefixSumArr[level] = (prefixSumArr[level] + (seqs[level].get(seqs[level].size() - 1) % M2)) % M2;
        if (level == 6) return;
        for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++) {
            generate(level + 1, 10 * val + i);
        }
    }

    static void compute(long x) {
        if (x > n) return;
        if (x * B + B - 1 <= n && x * B * 10 > n) {
            long rk = count;
            for (int i = 0, step = 1; i <= 6; i++, step *= 10) {
                int delta = (int)(((rk - x * step) % M1 + M1) % M1);
                int pos = lowerBound(seqs[i], -delta + M1);
                long sumSeq = 0;
                if (pos != -1) {
                    sumSeq = ((long) delta * seqs[i].size() % M2 + prefixSumArr[i]) % M2;
                }
                long subtractVal = (long)(seqs[i].size() - pos) * M1 % M2;
                result = (int)((result + (sumSeq - subtractVal + M2) % M2) % M2);
                count += seqs[i].size();
            }
            return;
        }
        count++;
        result = (int)((result + ((count - x) % M1 + M1) % M1) % M2);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++) {
            compute(x * 10 + i);
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Integer> list, int key) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= key) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low < list.size() ? low : -1;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine().trim());
        generate(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(seqs[i]);
        }
        count = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 9; i++) {
            compute(i);
        }
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
